WITH o AS (SELECT s.stellarref, s.hostplname, oc.period::numeric AS period, LAG(oc.period::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref ORDER BY oc.period) AS prev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref ORDER BY oc.period) AS rn FROM stars s JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref JOIN orbital_characteristics oc ON oc.bodylink = p.planetref WHERE s.compcount > 1 AND oc.period > 0),
g AS (SELECT stellarref, hostplname, MIN(period) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS inner_p, COUNT(prev) AS npairs, BOOL_AND(period / prev < 3) FILTER (WHERE prev IS NOT NULL) AS allc, EXP(AVG(LN(period / prev)) FILTER (WHERE prev IS NOT NULL)) AS gm FROM o GROUP BY stellarref, hostplname)
SELECT hostplname, ROUND(gm, 3) AS geometric_mean_period_ratio FROM g WHERE npairs >= 1 AND allc AND inner_p < 10 ORDER BY gm DESC

WITH c AS (SELECT s.stellarref, s.hostplname, (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric AS recorded_mass, o.semimajor::numeric AS a, o.period::numeric AS p, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.stellarref ORDER BY o.semimajor DESC) AS rn FROM stars s JOIN planets p ON p.hostlink = s.stellarref JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref WHERE s.compcount > 1 AND o.semimajor IS NOT NULL AND o.period > 0)
SELECT hostplname, recorded_mass, POWER(a, 3) / POWER(p / 365.25, 2) AS calculated_mass FROM c WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ABS(recorded_mass - POWER(a, 3) / POWER(p / 365.25, 2))

WITH pl AS (SELECT p.hostlink, ph.massjup, ph.densvalue FROM planets p JOIN physical_properties ph ON ph.objectlink = p.planetref WHERE ph.densvalue IS NOT NULL OR ph.massjup IS NOT NULL),
st AS (SELECT stellarref, (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::float8 AS r, (stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value')::float8 AS t FROM stars WHERE stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value' IS NOT NULL AND stellarprops->'physical'->>'Temp_Value' IS NOT NULL),
h AS (SELECT hostlink FROM pl GROUP BY hostlink HAVING BOOL_OR(densvalue > 3) AND NOT BOOL_OR(COALESCE(massjup > 0.1, false)))
SELECT ROUND(AVG(POWER(st.r, 2) * POWER(st.t / 5778.0, 4))::numeric, 4) AS avg_stellar_luminosity FROM st JOIN h ON h.hostlink = st.stellarref

SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_full_name, s.hostplname AS host_star, o.eccentricity, ROUND((ph.massjup::numeric * 1.898e27) / ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847e30), 5) AS mass_ratio
FROM planets p JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON o.bodylink = p.planetref JOIN physical_properties ph ON ph.objectlink = p.planetref JOIN data_quality_tracking d ON d.targetlink = p.planetref
WHERE o.eccentricity > 0.25 AND LOWER(d.masssource) = 'msini' AND ph.massjup IS NOT NULL AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY (ph.massjup::numeric * 1.898e27) / ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847e30) ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR((ph.massjup::numeric * 1.898e27) / ((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric * 1.98847e30), '9.999999EEEE') AS planet_star_mass_ratio
FROM planets p JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink JOIN physical_properties ph ON ph.objectlink = p.planetref
WHERE ph.massjup IS NOT NULL AND ph.radjup IS NOT NULL AND ph.densvalue IS NOT NULL AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric > 0
  AND ph.densvalue > 3 AND ph.massjup::numeric * 317.83 BETWEEN 1 AND 10
ORDER BY (ph.massjup::numeric * 317.83) / POWER(ph.radjup::numeric * 11.209, 2) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND((SQRT(2 * 6.674e-11 * (ph.massjup * 317.83 * 5.972e24) / (ph.radjup * 11.209 * 6.371e6)) / 1000)::numeric, 0) AS escape_velocity_km_s
FROM physical_properties ph WHERE ph.massjup > 0 AND ph.radjup > 0
ORDER BY (ph.massjup * 317.83) / (ph.radjup * 11.209) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS planet_count FROM physical_properties ph JOIN data_quality_tracking d ON d.targetlink = ph.objectlink WHERE ph.radjup IS NOT NULL AND d.limitflags->'planetary_limits'->>'Rad_Lim' = '1'

SELECT band, COUNT(*) AS star_count FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Photo_Band') IN ('v (johnson)', 'johnson', 'v', 'johnson v', 'v-band') THEN 'v-band' WHEN LOWER(stellarprops->'photometry'->>'Photo_Band') IN ('kepler-band', 'kepler', 'kep-b', 'kep') THEN 'kepler-band' END AS band FROM stars) x WHERE band IS NOT NULL GROUP BY band ORDER BY star_count DESC
